title: Chinese manufacturers dominate humanoid robot production, capturing 97% of global shipments in H1 2026, thanks to government support and vast supply chains (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Chinese manufacturers dominate humanoid robot production, capturing 97% of global shipments in H1 2026, thanks to government support and vast supply chains — Advanced humanoid hardware is one of the strategic high-tech fields where China has an early lead over the US.
